label: Matched plan and structural response profile
term: matched operative plan and structural response profile
definition: The Boolean profile index selects the existing operative or omission practical-plan control, with its benefit and end clauses held on. The same index selects the responsive or idle public-input mechanism. Operative coverage remains the existing rational-giving coverage proposition, not a new definition of actual intentional action. The supplied cut replaces only the second public input equation; its reading as an appraisal report and the pairing of coverage with the mechanism are fixed stipulations of the test.
note: This finite pairing licenses testing identifiability under a specified public surgery; it does not show that loss of divine cognition is feasible or that a particular causal response constitutes practical apprehension.
